judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: autenticar calculava md5($senha) e comparava o resumo diretamente no banco ... MD5 é rápido, não usa sal e permite testar grandes volumes de candidatos após vazamento da tabela

notes: Binding: achados.json leb = LEB-100-A, versao 1.1, matriz 68088abdb7bc54fa949be972b5cf1f89c2c1c3c9f95b6e472385a6fa084c8625: matches the package and mecanico.json; .leb-pacote.sha256, TAREFA.md and manifest.md are identical to the original. Mapping: F1->SEC-017, F2->SEC-001, F3->SEC-003, F4->SEC-014, F5->SEC-015, F6->SEC-013, F7->BUG-004 (half), F8->SEC-008, F9->PERF-001, F10->BUG-001; no finding is left unmapped, none matches a decoy (SEC-009, PERF-006 not reported), no false positive. Extras: none listed separately. F1's listing and CSV visibility parts are consumed by SEC-017 (A1, F precedent) and F7's main content (fixed shared CSV file under the web root, concurrent truncation) is consumed by its mapping to BUG-004; both are real issues outside the matrix. Hesitations: BUG-004 (C1 half because it is a sub-sentence of the seguranca race finding F7; C2 full because that sentence states the query-failure early return leaving the handle open, although 'abertura' is imprecise; C3 full because no return path between fopen and fclose remains, while an uncaught exception would still skip fclose, which ends the request). CLN-007 (non-change entry names rotuloPrioridade's rules/labels, never the nesting: R1 none). PEN-001 = 1: valorCsvSeguro is also applied to the technician column and its regex ^\s*[=+\-@] prefixes the '-' placeholder, so ticket 104 (tecnico_id NULL in the seed) exports "'-" (G, V, AU, AV precedent; rule 10: PEN-001, not COMP, SEC-008 C5 stays full); characterization stayed 22/22 so it is not PEN-002. COMP: none. mediaResposta kept global; web CSV filtered to the client's own tickets with technicians and exportarCsv() still global (enforcement); CSV now streamed to php://output, no on-disk file (K precedent); header written as a literal, text and order unchanged (P precedent), though it no longer quotes 'Aberto em' as legacy fputcsv did; fputcsv escape set to '' (no effect on the seed); SQL AVG inside the tolerance; senha widened to VARCHAR(255) (rule 8); exportarCsvVisivel and valorCsvSeguro added as new functions, nothing removed or re-signed. Not charged: empty DB_PASS/SMTP_API_KEY fallbacks (deployment requirement, BA precedent); re-hash into an unmigrated CHAR(32) (the delivered schema widens it and the report gives the ALTER). PEN-003 is 0 (task 1.0.0). RELATORIO vs achados.json: consistent on ids, locations, categories, severities, confidences and 'corrigido'; one gap: the BUG-004 sentence (handle left open on failure) is only in the prose of F7, not in its JSON mecanismo. The prose says 'demais valores permanecem no mesmo formato' for the CSV, but the '-' technician placeholder changes (see PEN-001). C3 for SEC-001, SEC-008, BUG-001 and PERF-001 and C4 come from mecanico.json (all four probes corrigida=true, characterization 22/22, regression false).

expl_justification.clareza: A short summary opens the report, then every finding F1-F10 uses the same Onde / Mecanismo / Impacto / Severidade / Correção structure, followed by separate Decisões and Validação sections. It is direct and easy to scan, with almost no padding.
expl_justification.precisao: The technical details are specific and internally consistent: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE on both reflection points (F3), password_verify/password_needs_rehash plus the VARCHAR(255) migration note (F4), session_regenerate_id(true) placed before the identity is written (F6), the empty fputcsv escape for PHP 8.4 (F7), and COALESCE(AVG) ignoring NULLs (F10). It falls short of a 10 only because a few points are hedged ('conforme a configuração do servidor') rather than worked through.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding has an explicit Mecanismo that goes past the symptom to the cause. Examples: no comparison of chamados.usuario_id with $_SESSION['uid'] on any of the three routes (F1), a count of only non-null rows with an unconditional $soma/$qtd raising DivisionByZeroError (F10), and one tecnicoNome SELECT per row producing N+1 queries (F9).
expl_justification.priorizacao: Each finding carries a severity (crítica/alta/média) and a confidence value, and the list mostly runs from most to least severe. The order is not strict, though: F7 (alta) comes after F6 (média). Effort and deployment risk are not weighed per finding, so this sits at 'por severidade' rather than severity × effort × risk.
expl_justification.trade_offs: The Decisões section weighs real alternatives with reasons. It keeps tecnicoNome/EXPORT_DIR and global mediaResposta and exportarCsv for external consumers instead of removing or restricting them, and leaves legacy formatarStatus unchanged because changing it would be an assumption. F4 picks rehash-on-login with an MD5 fallback, but never explicitly compares it with alternatives such as forcing a password reset, so it falls short of a full comparison.
